author: profbananaslug
body:
Part 1: About You

What is your age?
18 Year
What is your Discord ID? (If you don’t have Discord, create an account and join the Avicus Discord server before answering this question.)
profbananaslug#6145
How active can you be in order to contribute to the team?
The Profbananaslug is play Avicus every day, some would have even said it is too long and not benefit to Health
What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder?
I have not knowledge of other applicants, but it is of the likelihood that the Profbananaslug is of the having more Qualifications from his making of many Map and Xml and interaction with team of Map Developer.
Part 2: Skills

What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay?
This question is not of the much sense to me, but I will attempt. It is necessity for improvement to make lots of Practice with build, and to look when Map is played for the fixing the issue of gameplay.
How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors?
The Profbananaslug is of the highest competence with Xml of Avicus and the creation of and fixing of it. He is often at the edge of cutting by the use of infrequent Xml and even finds issue with Atlas, is also requested by Map Developer to find Xml error on some occasion.
As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both?
It is of probability that the Profbananaslug would be with focus on creation of Xml as he is not fast of the building of Maps, but he will be doing the both to his best Capability.
Part 3: Past Experience

Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums.
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/c3ad14a46
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/26d18876e
Both of inclusion in Avicus map Accumulation
Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.
Yes the Profbananaslug has also been involvement in Maps creation and Xml of numbers of other Map, with the inclusion of Alpine TE, Turbine, Maisosen Remasted, Foundry, Zeegaloo, Prysalus.
Part 4: Self Reflection

Why do you want to be a builder?
The Profbananaslug is having of the passion to the creating of Maps and Maps Xml, so it is only of the nature that Builder rank would be attractable to he. It is often noticed to be difficulty to be hurry of the Xml creation when not able to test in the development and have to rely on slow Map Developer and Developer to fix Xml when he could do it fast instead if able. Also, many others have been encourage he of apply for Builder, additionally.
How do you think you will help the map development team?
It has been noticed of me in past that the Map Developer is usually slow of the Xml so the Profbananaslug would be of the use to hurry process of Map addition and fixation.
mon vie est rien qu'un grand pièce d'art.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Congratulations. The Head Map Development Team has accepted you to embark on a journey to become a Builder. Please check discord for channel and expect your expectations as builder as well as the training documents. This will all be done by next Sunday so please be patient with us. 

Thanks!
- The Head MapDevs
